findings.explanation: Let P be the predicate passed to `select`. Lean proves by `rfl` that `instance' FEMPTY i name ty τ = (select P) FEMPTY i name ty τ`. HOL4 saves `instance_def` with a successful lookup as a premise. At `FEMPTY` that premise always fails. With a two-element result type, changing the specified function’s value at this input preserves `instance_def`, even with the choice operator held fixed. The saved specification therefore leaves this equation open.
findings.repair:
axiom instance' [Nonempty U] : tmsig → interpretation U → mlstring → type → tyval U → U

theorem instance_def [Nonempty U] (s : tmsig) (i : interpretation U) (name : mlstring) (ty ty0 : type) (tyin : List (type × type)) (h : FLOOKUP s name = some ty0 ∧ ty = TYPE_SUBST tyin ty0) :
    instance' s i name ty = fun τ => tmaof i name
      (MAP (typesem (tyaof i) τ ∘ TYPE_SUBST tyin ∘ Tyvar)
        (MAP implode (STRING_SORT (MAP explode (tyvars ty0))))) := by sorry
findings.lean_check:
import CandleLean.HolSemantics

namespace Candle

private def spec {U : Type} (f : tmsig → interpretation U → mlstring → type → tyval U → U) : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : tmsig) (i : interpretation U) (name : mlstring) (ty ty0 : type) (tyin : List (type × type)),
    FLOOKUP s name = some ty0 ∧ ty = TYPE_SUBST tyin ty0 →
    f s i name ty = fun τ => tmaof i name
      (MAP (typesem (tyaof i) τ ∘ TYPE_SUBST tyin ∘ Tyvar)
        (MAP implode (STRING_SORT (MAP explode (tyvars ty0)))))

example (i : interpretation Bool) (name : mlstring) (ty : type) (τ : tyval Bool) :
    instance' FEMPTY i name ty τ = (select (spec (U := Bool))) FEMPTY i name ty τ := rfl

end Candle

findings.explanation: Lean gives `Abs (Const name ty) b` the value `ARB` for every body and valuation. HOL4 saves an abstraction equation only for `Abs (Var x ty) b`. Its equations leave the value of an abstraction with a constant binder open. The same issue applies to `Comb` and `Abs` binders.
findings.repair:
private opaque unspecifiedAbs [Nonempty U] (mem : U → U → Prop) (s : tmsig) (i : interpretation U) (v : valuation U) (binder body : term) : U := ARB

def termsem0 [Nonempty U] (mem : U → U → Prop) (tmsig : Candle.tmsig) (i : interpretation U) : valuation U → term → U
  | v, Var x ty => tmvof v (x, ty)
  | v, Const name ty => instance' tmsig i name ty (tyvof v)
  | v, Comb t1 t2 => apply mem (termsem0 mem tmsig i v t1) (termsem0 mem tmsig i v t2)
  | v, Abs (Var x ty) b =>
    abstract mem (typesem (tyaof i) (tyvof v) ty) (typesem (tyaof i) (tyvof v) (typeof b))
      (fun m => termsem0 mem tmsig i (tyvof v, UPDATE (x, ty) m (tmvof v)) b)
  | v, Abs binder b => unspecifiedAbs mem tmsig i v binder b
findings.lean_check:
import CandleLean.HolSemantics

namespace Candle

example {U : Type} [Nonempty U] (mem : U → U → Prop) (s : tmsig) (i : interpretation U) (v : valuation U) (name : mlstring) (ty : type) (b : term) :
    termsem0 mem s i v (Abs (Const name ty) b) = ARB := by
  simp only [termsem0]

end Candle
